title: MatchWise · Service Comparison

panels.title: MatchWise · Service Comparison
panels.description: Side-by-side service comparison with an identical structure.

options.content:
**The same panel for every service.** Fixed colours: blue frontend · orange backend · green database · purple Oracle. Series on one panel share a unit; where a service collects no data the tile shows *n/a*, not zero.

Order: **Scorecard → Availability → Load → Errors → Security signals**. Database error rate is the rolled-back transaction share and its traffic is transactions/min: not HTTP requests. The detailed browser view is at the bottom.

**Frontend host:** host CPU/memory metrics for this static Vercel frontend are unavailable to this monitoring system; browser telemetry does not measure them. Resource cards are shown for the backend, database and Oracle VM only.

options.content: **Last five minutes, excluding health checks.** HTTP 401/403/404/429 counts are investigation signals, not proof of an attack. Missing results do not mean zero events. No IP or account attribution is collected; a 429 panel does not prove that rate limiting is implemented.

options.content: **Advanced view: two separate vertical axes.** Left and right axes use different units; curve heights cannot be compared directly. The separate main-view plots are easier to read. Database transactions are not backend requests; the queue covers only the PostgREST connection pool.

panels.title: API traffic ↔ Database transactions · Two axes
panels.description: Backend API requests/min (left), Supabase committed transactions/s (right), both 5m averages. Database-wide activity includes internal services and other clients. Different units; no expected numerical equality.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"(/api/health|/health)" | route=~"(/api(/.*)?|/(auth|cv|jobs|profile|preferences|me)(/.*)?)" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Backend CPU ↔ Database transactions · Two axes
panels.description:
Render CPU % (left, API sample) and database-wide committed transactions/s (right, 5m average). CPU-heavy application work may legitimately cause little database activity; the graph is context, not an anomaly verdict.

A value outside 0–100% is an invalid sample; it is not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: (matchwise_render_cpu_utilization_percent{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"}) and ((matchwise_render_metrics_collection_success{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} == 1) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 240) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_source_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 300) and on(job,instance) (up{job="node_exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="node_exporter"} == 0))

panels.title: Backend P95 ↔ PostgREST queue · Two axes
panels.description: Backend logged processing P95 in ms over 5m (left); PostgREST pool waiting requests sampled every 60s (right). Not a PostgreSQL lock-wait or total database queue metric. Short queue spikes may fall between scrapes; missing data is not zero.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"(/api/health|/health)" | route=~"(/api(/.*)?|/(auth|cv|jobs|profile|preferences|me)(/.*)?)" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (job)

options.content:
**Real browser traffic; 60-second batches.** Rates use five-minute averages and may not yet include the first events of a new counter series. Cumulative counts below help when traffic is low.

**Network error ≠ HTTP 4xx/5xx.** Aborted requests have no HTTP response, so failed outcomes are shown separately. Routes are groups (auth, cv, jobs…), not full URLs.

**The last batch contains a snapshot from one reporting page**, not the sum of all open browsers. Delivery counters accumulate since that page started and are captured when its batch is created; they have no safe global sum. Observed maxima are measured since the Oracle receiver started. Issue-reporting batches can repeat an old issue rather than indicate a new failure.

**Batch delay may include browser–Oracle clock skew**, so it can be negative and is not pure network latency. Missing data ≠ zero. Fresh snapshots disappear when the latest real batch is older than three minutes; cumulative counts and maxima require a successful receiver scrape.

Route-detail plots use consistent route-group colors across panels.

panels.title: API starts · By route group
panels.description: Five-minute averages by auth, cv, jobs and other route groups. These are not user counts.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_requests_started_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: P95 to response headers · By route group (estimated)
panels.description: Histogram-estimated browser time until HTTP response headers, not backend processing time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route,le) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_bucket{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m]))) * 1000 and on(route) (sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_count{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: Outcomes · HTTP response, network error, abort
panels.description: http: an HTTP response arrived, including error status codes; network_error: no HTTP response arrived; aborted: request was cancelled.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(frontend_api_outcomes_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

sum by (status) (rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: HTTP error rate · 4xx and 5xx
panels.description:
Share of observed HTTP responses only. Excludes network errors and aborts. No ratio is shown without a positive response rate; no artificial 0% is displayed.

A value outside 0–100% is an invalid sample; it is not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: (100 * ((sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) or on() (0 * sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) / sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) and on() (sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: HTTP errors · By route group
panels.description: 4xx/5xx responses since the receiver extension was installed. Historical route-to-status relationships cannot be reconstructed from older metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_results_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

sum by (method) (rate(frontend_api_requests_started_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: Longest time to response headers · Since receiver restart
panels.description: Exact largest observed duration_max_ms by route since receiver restart. This is neither P95 nor a five-minute maximum. Restarts with the receiver.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description:
In-flight requests · Last reporting page

API requests still in flight on the last reporting page when its batch was created. Not total simultaneous requests across all browsers.

panels.title: Batch delay
panels.description:
Batch delay · Includes clock skew

Receiver arrival time minus the client-reported window end. May include retry delay and client clock skew; can be negative.

panels.title: Batch window
panels.description:
Aggregation window · Last batch

Reported window end minus start. Background tabs, pending delivery and retries can affect the nominal 60-second interval.

panels.title: Receiver schema
panels.description:
Receiver · Extended metrics version

2 = receiver with extended metrics. The frontend batch schema is still version 1; no frontend deployment is required.

panels.title: Successful deliveries
panels.description:
Successful deliveries · Last page report

Cumulative value since the last reporting page started, captured when the batch was created. Do not sum across batches or browsers. Does not yet include the delivery result of this batch.

panels.title: Failed attempts
panels.description:
Failed delivery attempts · Last page report

Cumulative value since the last reporting page started, captured when the batch was created. Do not sum across batches or browsers. Does not yet include the delivery result of this batch.

panels.title: Dropped batches
panels.description:
Dropped batches · Last page report

Cumulative value since the last reporting page started, captured when the batch was created. Do not sum across batches or browsers. Does not yet include the delivery result of this batch.

panels.title: Dropped observations
panels.description:
Dropped observations · Last page report

Cumulative value since the last reporting page started, captured when the batch was created. Do not sum across batches or browsers. Does not yet include the delivery result of this batch.

panels.title: Delivery issues · Largest reported page counters
panels.description: Largest cumulative per-page diagnostic values observed since receiver restart. Not global error totals or counts of new incidents.

panels.title: Batches reporting delivery issues/min
panels.description: Rate of accepted unique batches reporting a positive issue counter. An older issue can appear in many subsequent batches; this is not the number of new failures.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (rate(frontend_telemetry_reports_with_delivery_issue_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: Receiver quality · Duplicate, rejected and rate-limited batches
panels.description: The Oracle receiver counters include production and test delivery. Duplicate batches do not increase business counters again.

panels.title: Detailed dimensions · Observations folded at the limit
panels.description: Detailed route/method/status/outcome combinations are capped at 4096. Additional dimensions fold into other/OTHER; overall traffic, HTTP status counts and timing histograms remain available. A missing series can mean no observation has exceeded the cap yet.

panels.title: API starts · Since receiver restart
panels.description: Observed API starts by route group since receiver restart. Includes first observations even when traffic is low; resets on restart. Not session or user counts.

panels.title: Results · Since receiver restart
panels.description: Observed results by route group since the receiver extension, including network errors and aborts. Need not equal request starts.

panels.title: Mean time to response headers · By route group
panels.description: Mean time to response headers by route group, for requests receiving an HTTP response only.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_sum{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_count{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m]))) * 1000 and on(route) (sum by (route) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_count{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: Results · By method and outcome
panels.description: Detailed results by method and outcome. Above the dimension limit, methods fold into OTHER; overall result counts are retained.

targets.expr: sum by (method,outcome) (rate(frontend_api_results_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) * 60 and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

description: Side-by-side service comparison with an identical structure: scorecard, availability, load, errors, security signals. Fixed service colours, shared units, n/a where no data is collected.
